name: search for an expression evaluating to an exact target
definition: Using the allowed numbers, arithmetic operators (+ - * /), and parentheses, find an expression whose value equals the target exactly.
failure_mode: An expression that approximates instead of equal fails the eval equality.

name: securely overwrite then remove sensitive files and their directories
definition: Overwrite each file multiple times with a secure-deletion tool, unlink it, then remove the now-empty parent directory.
failure_mode: Leaving the directory or any file fails the gone-check.
